name: clean-paste-input
title: Clean Paste Input
description: Strips zero-width, BOM, soft-hyphen and bidi control characters on paste, says what was removed with an undo, and flags any that arrive by typing or autofill with a one-tap fix.

meta.stops: Pasted code fails from hidden characters
meta.summary: Strips invisible characters from pasted codes and IDs, so values that look identical don't fail for hidden reasons.
catches: Zero-width spaces and joiners, and byte-order marks
Hidden characters arriving by other routes than paste, with a fix
limits: Doesn't change visible look-alike characters (Cyrillic а for Latin a)
Removing joiners can change text in scripts or emoji that need them; use undo where that matters
a11y: Visible <label>; the field is described by an aria-live="polite" notice
Undo and dismiss are buttons; dismiss has an aria-label
Actions return focus to the field
